Do you love turning complex rewards- and people data into clear business insights? And would you like to work at the intersection of Rewards, Finance and People Analytics in an international business?

At Royal Unibrew, we are looking for a Senior Analyst, Rewards to strengthen our global Rewards agenda and bring even more analytical power to how we understand and manage our workforce costs, pay structures and market competitiveness.

This is particularly attractive for an ambitious Rewards professional who is ready to take the next step in their career. It’s a role for someone who enjoys digging into the data, finding the story behind the numbers and turning complexity into insights. You will work across our global markets and collaborate closely with HR, Finance and business stakeholders, providing insights that support both our day-to-day decisions and our longer-term Rewards agenda.

A key part of your role will also be supporting our journey towards increased pay transparency, strengthening our governance and ensuring that our approach is both compliant and practical for the business.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Drive global FTE, headcount and salary cost analysis, including forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis

• Partner with HR and Finance across markets on workforce cost insights and scenario modelling

• Support implementation of the EU Pay Transparency Directive, including pay equity and pay gap analysis

• Strengthen governance around job architecture, salary structures and Rewards data

• Conduct salary benchmarking and analyse market competitiveness across countries

• Provide analytical support for salary review processes

• Develop dashboards and management reporting

• Turn complex data into insights and actionable recommendations

**What You Bring

**You may already be operating as a specialist, analyst or rewards partner and be looking for an opportunity where you can further expand your influence, business impact and leadership potential within the Rewards field. You have a strong analytical background from areas such as Rewards, People Analytics, HR, Controlling, Workforce Planning or Finance.

**We Are Looking For Experience With

**

• Workforce cost management and financial analysis

• Data analytics and large datasets

• Pay Transparency and Pay Equity

• Compensation benchmarking and salary structures

• Job architecture and Rewards governance

• Advanced Excel and preferably Power BI

• HR-systems, ideally SAP SuccessFactors

You are analytical, structured and curious, with strong business acumen. You enjoy getting into the detail, but you also know how to zoom out, identify what matters and communicate it clearly to stakeholders.

**Why Royal Unibrew?

**We are ambitious, informal and always moving. At Royal Unibrew, you will join an international business with a strong entrepreneurial spirit, where decisions are made close to the business and good ideas can quickly turn into action.

You will be trusted to take ownership, challenge how we do things and make your mark. Expect a fast-paced and down-to-earth environment with high ambitions, great colleagues and plenty of opportunities to learn, contribute and have fun along the way.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

**The Role as Senior QC Scientist (BioAssay)

**Are you motivated by the opportunity to help build something from the ground up? Genmab is establishing a QC Laboratory, and we are looking for a Senior QC Scientist for a BioAssay team to play a central role in this work.

This is a unique opportunity to help implement methods, shape key processes, and set the standard for how our QC organization will operate in the years ahead.

You will play a key role in the establishment of the laboratory which includes and is not limited to: Method transfers, Validation of Analytical methods, authoring and reviewing laboratory procedures, and supporting qualification of new analytical instruments.

Collaboration and cross-site training with our analytical development group in Utrecht and analytical SME´s in Copenhagen will also be expected in the beginning

The position is an onsite role in our QC Lab in Ballerup and reports to Associate Director, Head of QC BioAssay

**Once In Operation Daily Tasks Includes

**

• Reviewing release and stability analyzes,

• Supporting and training fellow scientists and lab technicians

• Documenting validation activities of analytical methods for clinical phase I/II and III and authoring SOPs.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree or PhD in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, biotechnology, or related scientific area.

• At least 6+ years of experience in a Quality Control (QC) or analytical development (AD) laboratory or a PhD degree with 3+ years of working experience.

• Strong understanding of analytical science and its application across clinical development stages.

• Good understanding of validation concepts, risk-based approaches, and regulatory expectations.

• Experience with systems and tools relevant to QC (e.g. LIMS, SAS-Jmp, SoftMaxPro)

• You have experience with ELISA´s and pharmacopeia methods for biologics.

**Why Join Us?

**This is a rare opportunity to shape a laboratory from the ground up. You will be part of a highly motivated and international team, working with cutting-edge science and innovative therapies. If you are energized by challenges, driven by curiosity, and eager to see your impact on both processes and people, we want you on the team.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. **The Role

**The Associate Director, External Data Acquisition Lead (EDAL) role is a clinical data manager with expertise in the data collection of 3rd party data from various external providers (e.g. laboratories, eCOA providers, technology providers, etc.). The EDAL provides a leadership role in the oversight of the external clinical data integration processes as well as oversight of data quality from various external providers performing testing or data collection services on behalf of Genmab. The EDAL serves as the subject matter expert for all external data management activities performed for clinical trial teams. This role provides strategic data management expertise and is accountable for all end-to-end Data Management activities and deliverables pertaining to external data. The employee will provide oversight of external vendors and the data and/or data services they provide to Genmab. The External Data Lead will support the development and optimization of processes and tools to enable success of the Clinical Operations department. The employee will represent Data Management in Operational Committee’s/fora with the partners and/or DM/stat vendors. The employee will support /train colleagues in and advise on handling of external data management related processes/issues and may act as a mentor. Moreover, the employee shall support the overall strategy and development of Data Management by attending/leading task force initiatives within the department and/or as part of cross-departmental teams.

**Responibilites

**

• Lead external data acquisition across one or more studies/programs, ensuring high-quality, timely, analysis-ready data aligned with trial objectives.

• Influence protocol and amendment development by advising on external data collection design, integration feasibility, and alignment with CDASH/SDTM and EDC requirements.

• Lead planning and oversight of external data flow strategies and DTS across diverse data types (PK/ADA, biomarker, imaging, central lab, eCOA/ePRO, PD, IRT, etc.) to ensure compliant integration.

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure external data acquisition supports operational and scientific goals.

• Develop and manage Trial Data Integrity Plans (TDIP) and Data Flow

• Create and maintain data transfer specifications (DTS) requirements. Ensure data collection requirements are aligned with external vendor capabilities and vendor data are compatible with the clinical database and SDTM requirements to support data integration, analysis and reporting. Ensure vendor data is transferred in standard data formats.

• Provide thorough review of external vendors budget and change order

• Act as escalation point for complex vendor issues (timeline deviations, integration challenges, misalignment to trial needs).

• Mentor and guide junior External Data Acquisition Leads, providing direction on best practices, issue resolution, and development.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives including SOP development, process improvement, tools optimization, and external data standards governance.

• Partner with procurement/legal/vendor managers to review technical language in contracts and work orders, ensuring alignment with Genmab standards and systems.

• Promote portfolio-level consistency and scalability through training, knowledge sharing, and strategic planning support.

• Mentor and develop team members to ensure consistency of External Data Management practices.

• Ensure External Vendor deliverables are performed in compliance with protocol, ICH, GCP and SOPs

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master's degree in a relevant technical area; Master’s degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in external or clinical data management, with strong third-party vendor oversight and data acquisition experience.

• Experience working on Oncology trials/data

• Experience designing and governing DTS and complex data flows supporting EDC integration and CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM).

• Strong knowledge of diverse external data types (e.g., biomarker, central lab, imaging, eCOA/ePRO, genomic) and ability to align acquisition strategies to clinical and analytical objectives.

• Experience managing projects, vendors, and process improvements in global environments.

• Proven performance in earlier role.

Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. As Senior Engineering Manager for Content Platform, you own the systems that acquire and ingest the content our entire product line reasons about. Our enterprise customers bring thousands of sites each, re-crawled continuously. Every accessibility finding, analytics number, and SEO recommendation begins as content one of your systems fetched, parsed, and stored.

You will lead two Copenhagen engineering teams, each with its own Technical Leader role held by a Principal Engineer. The two carry different hard problems. One sustains crawl throughput so that cost tracks value rather than volume. The other builds the shared foundations the rest of Siteimprove works through, so product lines reach content through common contracts rather than each solving it their own way. You represent this group's engineering in a trio with Product and UX. Pillar strategy is set with Seattle, nine hours behind you, and you are the leader on the ground who turns it into local decisions rather than waiting on it.

Your teams set the ceiling on what the rest of Siteimprove can build. Your goals follow from that — ingestion reliable enough that customers trust it, efficient enough that cost tracks value rather than volume, capable enough to feed our agentic products, and ready for the compliance bar our public sector customers require. You will use AI to build the platform that powers our AI products and stay close enough to the code to argue a design on its merits.

What we will be doing

• Decision Authority in Copenhagen: You are the decision-maker on the ground. Resolve in Copenhagen hours what would otherwise wait overnight. As engineering's voice in the group's trio, bring the constraints Product and UX have no way to see into scope conversations early enough to change them. Your director sets goals with you and discusses how you and the group are tracking against them.

• Platform Ownership: Own Content Platform's ingestion surface as a running business — availability, throughput, cost, and delivery predictability. Modernization is how you improve those numbers, not a separate program you report on. Our move to EKS is part of it. You decide which debt gets paid down and when and keep that trade-off in front of the trio.

• Architectural Direction: Own the constraints and the cross-team contracts your Technical Leaders design within: scheduling the crawl workload so cost tracks value rather than volume, moving ingestion onto event-driven services, and defining how the rest of Siteimprove consumes what we ingest. Align directly with peer engineering leaders and close the gaps at functions you depend on but don't manage.

We’re looking for a product engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 40+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

We have has raised more than €4M, including a €2.9M seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and a strong bench of angels. We already serve 400+ customers across Denmark, Germany, and Switzerland, and we're just getting started.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Global Support Functions IT
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**VELUX is the world's most recognised brand in roof windows and skylights, with a genuine mission: creating better living environments through daylight and fresh air. Backed by a foundation with a long-term ownership philosophy, this is a company that thinks in decades, not quarters.

IT in VELUX is entering a new chapter. A new strategy is taking shape, it is high on the Group agenda, and it comes with a clear long-term view of where we are going. At its heart is, of course AI and all the new tech, but even more so, are the platforms that run the business: SAP and Workday, supporting Finance, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and People & Organisation.

With a strong foundation already in place, we’re now looking for a leader to take it to the next level - evolving from classic ERP toward AI-enabled ways of working. For a leader who enjoys transformation, wants to shape a roadmap rather than simply run one, and gets energy from solving real problems, this role is worth a conversation.

**What You Will Lead

**You will be accountable for the strategy, delivery, and operation of the enterprise platforms behind VELUX global support functions and be a leader of leaders.

As part of a newly established IT leadership team, reporting to the CIO, you will contribute to the strategic IT agenda beyond your own area. You will own the budget, the key vendor relationships, and the portfolio of programmes across the support functions.

**What The Role Actually Involves

****Stabilising the core and delivering upgrades

**You’ll lead our work on platform reliability: setting up a clear roadmap, solving problems at their source, and keeping stakeholders informed and supported along the way.

**Rethinking the support model

**You’ll have the opportunity to reshape our SAP and Workday support model, building on what works today, including our partnership with an external provider, and shaping how it evolves.

**Prioritising with the business

**The transformation has strong backing, and a big part of the role is making sure effort goes where it creates the most value. With an established PMO behind you, you’ll strengthen portfolio governance and build alignment on priorities.

**Leading the AI shift

**AI is changing everything, including traditional systems. You will help define what AI-enabled ways of working mean for our applications and for our organisation. It is new ground for everyone, and mindset matters as much as technology.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You’re a hands-on IT leader who thinks strategically but isn’t afraid to get into the details. When something breaks, you look past the quick fix to find the real cause, bring the right people together, and make sure it gets properly resolved. People trust you because you deliver on what you promise.

You work in a lean, practical way, and when setting priorities, you involve people rather than handing down a list. You help stakeholders reach a shared view of what matters most, while keeping the conversation focused and constructive.

We are particularly interested in candidates who bring:

• 10+ years of IT leadership, including leading global, multi-disciplinary organisations.

• Experience with enterprise SAP landscapes across Finance, Sales, and Operations/Supply Chain; S/4HANA experience is a strong advantage.

• Experience with HR technology platforms, ideally Workday is an advantage.

• A track record of leading large upgrades and multi-year transformations in a global, matrixed organisation.

• Strong vendor management, including contracts with global system integrators and managed-service providers.

• Curiosity about AI and automation, and a practical view on how they can change the way we work.

• Experience from a manufacturing company is a distinct advantage, and from the building materials industry is a plus.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential.

That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

**Help Write Our Next Chapter

**As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

**What Makes You Shine

**You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

**We would love to hear from you if you bring:

**

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

**Crafting What’s Next, Together

**You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

**The Impact You Will Make

**Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

**The Additional Sparkle

**You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

**Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

**If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Let’s Craft the Incredible

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next
